description: Create a new Check Setting in OneUptime. Returns the created Check Setting object with its ID. Use this to add new Check Settings to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

checkId.description: The built-in check this setting changes.

note.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

projectId.description: ID of the project this check setting belongs to.

severityOverride.description: The severity every failure of the check gets, instead of the one its store's sensitivity sets.
